config.title: Which weather forecast source gives the best next-day Delhi PM2.5 prediction? (isolated, retrospective)

live_system_facts.weather_source: Open-Meteo Forecast API, no `models` parameter, i.e. its default `best_match` blend (core/weather.py fetch_forecast_weather, called from backend/forecast_handler.py)
live_system_facts.coordinates: LAT/LON environment variables are not set in template.yaml, so the handler defaults 28.6139, 77.2090 are used
live_system_facts.daily_aggregation: tomorrow's 24 hourly values (Asia/Kolkata calendar day): mean temp / rh / wind / pressure, summed precipitation, mean wind vector (u, v); an hour with any missing variable is dropped; fewer than 12 hours -> no value
live_system_facts.issue_time: cron(30 17 * * ? *) = 17:30 UTC = 23:00 IST; target = next calendar day (horizon 1 day); PM2.5 inputs up to 22:59 IST
live_system_facts.wx0_today: today's weather (wx0_*) is also read from the same forecast response; no archive of that analysis exists, so wx0 stays ERA5 for every source in this experiment

archive.primary_lead: previous_day1 (value forecast 24 h before the valid hour)
archive.safe_lead: previous_day2 (48 h; every run it uses was published long before 23:00 IST)
archive.not_used_as_input: Historical Forecast API (stitched first hours of each run = analysis-like, would use information from the target day itself) and Single Runs API (archived only from 2026-04-02 except IFS HRES from 2024-03-14: no winter coverage) - both are used only to document availability / run mapping

windows.frozen_fit: one fit per winter on origins with target before 15 Oct, production recipe, no refit, no source-specific tuning

primary_dates.P4: identical dates in both winters where production_default, gfs_global, icon_global and ecmwf_ifs025 all have usable hours (primary comparison)
primary_dates.P6: 2025-26 only, adds ecmwf_ifs_hres and ecmwf_aifs025 (reported separately because their archives do not cover 2024-25)

arms.A_input_swap: train on ERA5 weather (production recipe); test with the source's archived forecast. Isolates the forecast source.
arms.B_source_trained: train on the source's own archived forecast where it exists and ERA5 before the archive starts (substitution counted and reported; a SEPARATE experiment, never mixed into A)
arms.B_strict: train only on origins with that source's forecast; run only when at least 365 such origins exist, otherwise reported as insufficient coverage

config.decomposition: total = B_source - A_production = (A_source - A_production) [source effect] + (B_source - A_source) [training effect]; the production source's own B - A is the control for training coverage

recommend_for_forward_test_only_if_all: arm A, lead 1, pooled P4 (or the single winter for P6 sources): Hybrid MAE at least 2 percent lower than production_default
95 percent interval of the difference entirely below zero for BOTH 7- and 14-day blocks
the point estimate is negative in every winter the source covers, and no winter is more than 2 percent worse
exact-category accuracy not lower by more than 2 percentage points
arm A with lead 2 (strictly available forecasts) has a negative point estimate too
decision_rule.single_winter_sources: ecmwf_ifs_hres and ecmwf_aifs025 cover one winter, so 'consistent across winters' can not be shown; they can at most be named as a candidate to log during winter 2026-27
decision_rule.never: change the live Lambda, the default model, the dashboard, checksums or the frozen forward-test protocol; commit, push or deploy

label: RETROSPECTIVE: winters 2024-25 and 2025-26 were examined in earlier experiments; not an untouched test
